nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI workflow that runs the full test matrix on push/PR to main: two parallel jobs (test, e2e) covering go mod tidy/vet/test/build, bats, web vitest + tsc typecheck, cloud wire/relay build, and Playwright e2e against chromium.
nodes.languageNotes: Concurrency group 'ci-${{ github.ref }}' with cancel-in-progress serializes revisions; both jobs share the same cloud-deps prerequisite because the web bundle imports @noble/@scure from cloud/* via vite alias.

nodes.name: test
nodes.summary: Primary CI test job: installs Go (from go.mod) and Node 24, pre-installs cloud workspace deps (pnpm@10 frozen-lockfile) and web deps (npm ci), then runs go mod tidy -diff, go vet, go test, go build, bats tests/, web vitest, web tsc -b --noEmit, cloud wire/relay build/type-check, and finally a guard check that internal/serve/dist is in sync with the web build.

nodes.name: e2e
nodes.summary: Parallel CI end-to-end job: re-installs cloud + web deps, installs Playwright chromium with system deps, runs `npm run e2e` (which builds the web bundle and executes Playwright tests), and uploads the playwright-report artifact on failure with 7-day retention.

nodes.name: release.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions release workflow that runs GoReleaser on version tags (v*) to build cross-platform binaries and publish a GitHub Release; uses contents: write permission and the workflow GITHUB_TOKEN.

nodes.name: goreleaser
nodes.summary: Release job that checks out the repo with full history (fetch-depth: 0 for changelog), sets up Go from go.mod, then invokes goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v6 with `release --clean` to build and publish the binary via GITHUB_TOKEN.
